dialogues.jp: 半ドンの放課後。
dialogues.en: It's after school on a half-day.
dialogues.text: It's after school on a half-day.

dialogues.jp:
俺達３人は商店街の茶屋に集まり、さくらの無
実を証明するための会議をすることになった。
dialogues.en:
The three of us met at a cafeteria to talk about how to
prove Sakura's innocent.
dialogues.text:
The three of us met at a cafeteria to talk about how to
prove Sakura's innocent.

dialogues.jp:
異様な文字の書かれた画用紙をしまって、杉並
が頷く。
dialogues.en:
Suginami nods and puts away a piece of notepaper with weird
things written on it.
dialogues.text:
Suginami nods and puts away a piece of notepaper with weird
things written on it.

dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと待て杉並……さくら｛・・・／ちゃん｝、ってな
　んだ？」
dialogues.en: "Wait a second, Suginami. What's 'Sakura-chan' about?"
dialogues.text: "Wait a second, Suginami. What's 'Sakura-chan' about?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「こういうのは雰囲気が大切だからな。徹夜の
　すえの傑作だ」
dialogues.en:
"It's all about the atmosphere. It was a masterpiece created
in an all-night vigil."
dialogues.text:
"It's all about the atmosphere. It was a masterpiece created
in an all-night vigil."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「すいません、桜餅のセット３つくださ〜い♪」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me, can I have three sets of cherry rice cake?"
dialogues.text: "Excuse me, can I have three sets of cherry rice cake?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Huhh..."
dialogues.text: "Huhh..."

dialogues.jp: ため息をついて空を見上げる。
dialogues.en: I sigh and look up at the sky.
dialogues.text: I sigh and look up at the sky.

dialogues.jp: まったくもって、だるいの極地に到達しそうだ。
dialogues.en: This is an ultimate tiring situation for me.
dialogues.text: This is an ultimate tiring situation for me.

dialogues.jp:
よくなんとか３人組とかあるが、このメンバー
は、ボケとかツッコミを超えた理解不能の構成
なのだろう。
dialogues.en:
I know a group of three is a classic comedy setup, but I
believe this one is beyond a joke. Perhaps we can be an
incomprehensible group.
dialogues.text:
I know a group of three is a classic comedy setup, but I
believe this one is beyond a joke. Perhaps we can be an
incomprehensible group.

dialogues.jp:
「で、あれから３日かけて、考えてきた作戦の
　発表だろうが」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, this is the time to show our strategy after three
days of thinking."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, this is the time to show our strategy after three
days of thinking."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、その件だが――」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, about the issue..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, about the issue..."

dialogues.jp:
お品書きを開きながら、杉並がことりに目配せ
する。
dialogues.en: Opening the list, Suginami gives Kotori a significant look.
dialogues.text: Opening the list, Suginami gives Kotori a significant look.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あのね、時間もないし、適任の仕事を３人で
　役割分担しようと思うの」
dialogues.en:
"You know what? We don't have much time, so we should share
the roles."
dialogues.text:
"You know what? We don't have much time, so we should share
the roles."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「役割分担？」
dialogues.en: "Share the roles?"
dialogues.text: "Share the roles?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん。私が事件と関係のある人への聞き込み
　を、杉並くんが学園のデータを調べるの」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. I interview people who've been involved in the
incidents, and Suginami checks the school database."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. I interview people who've been involved in the
incidents, and Suginami checks the school database."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、妥当なところか」
dialogues.en: "Well, I think it's reasonable."
dialogues.text: "Well, I think it's reasonable."

dialogues.jp: 緑茶をすすりながら考える。
dialogues.en: I think about it while sipping green tea.
dialogues.text: I think about it while sipping green tea.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは人受けがいいし、逆に杉並を対人関係
の仕事に就かせるのは自爆行為だ。
となると、自然と単独行動になるわけだ。
dialogues.en: That means I act all by myself.
dialogues.text: That means I act all by myself.

dialogues.jp:
「俺は？　あんまり得意なことはないけど、こ
　とりの手伝いでもしようか？」
dialogues.en:
"How about me? I don't have many skills, but I want to
support her somehow."
dialogues.text:
"How about me? I don't have many skills, but I want to
support her somehow."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前には、重要な仕事を残しておいた……く
　くく」
dialogues.en: "I have the most important job for you, heh heh heh."
dialogues.text: "I have the most important job for you, heh heh heh."

dialogues.jp:
『スーパー納豆あんみつ　３０００円（税抜）』
で指を止めたまま、杉並が嫌な笑いを浮かべる。
dialogues.en:
'Super sweet fermented-beans parfait, 3000 yen, no tax'.
Suginami gives a creepy grin with still fingers.
dialogues.text:
'Super sweet fermented-beans parfait, 3000 yen, no tax'.
Suginami gives a creepy grin with still fingers.

dialogues.jp: 「電話番とかだとすごく嬉しいんだけどな……」
dialogues.en: "It'd be great if I could be on phone duty..."
dialogues.text: "It'd be great if I could be on phone duty..."

dialogues.jp: 言うだけ言ってみて、無理だと悟る。
dialogues.en:
I say all I can think of, but then discover it's a futile
request.
dialogues.text:
I say all I can think of, but then discover it's a futile
request.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君には、なるべく芳乃さんと一緒にいて
　欲しいの」
dialogues.en: "I want you to hang around Yoshino-san as much as you can."
dialogues.text: "I want you to hang around Yoshino-san as much as you can."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「護衛……って言うか、見張りか」
dialogues.en: "I'm a bodyguard or a kind of lookout, huh?"
dialogues.text: "I'm a bodyguard or a kind of lookout, huh?"

dialogues.jp:
なにか事件があったときに、最低でもさくらと
俺が一緒にいれば保険にはなるか。
dialogues.en:
In case something happens to her, I can protect her at
least.
dialogues.text:
In case something happens to her, I can protect her at
least.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「適材適所なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Placing the right person in the right place."
dialogues.text: "Placing the right person in the right place."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「分かったよ。まぁ、誰かがさくら自身を見守っ
　ててやらんとな」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, I got it. In any case, somebody has to watch over
her, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Okay, I got it. In any case, somebody has to watch over
her, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん、なんか嬉しそうね？」
dialogues.en: "Hm, you look so happy."
dialogues.text: "Hm, you look so happy."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: "Do I?"
dialogues.text: "Do I?"

dialogues.jp: 頬杖をついて湯飲みを口にくわえる。
dialogues.en: Resting my chin in my hand, I hold the teacup with my mouth.
dialogues.text: Resting my chin in my hand, I hold the teacup with my mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ふふふ……じゃ、そういうことで第一回目の
　会議を終了します」
dialogues.en: "Heehee... This is all for the first meeting."
dialogues.text: "Heehee... This is all for the first meeting."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「出来ればベッドの中まで守って尽くして――
　ぶっ！？」
dialogues.en:
"If you can, you could protect her all the way inside her
bed - Guhh!"
dialogues.text:
"If you can, you could protect her all the way inside her
bed - Guhh!"

dialogues.jp:
音夢直伝の裏拳を杉並にぶちこんで、ことりに
詰め寄る。
dialogues.en:
I give him a punch that I learned from Nemu and walk over to
Kotori.
dialogues.text:
I give him a punch that I learned from Nemu and walk over to
Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
「終わりって、まだ役職だけしか決めてないの
　に？　杉並がこの前もらってたプリントは？」
dialogues.en:
"All we're doing today is assigning roles? What about the
batch of copies Suginami got yesterday?"
dialogues.text:
"All we're doing today is assigning roles? What about the
batch of copies Suginami got yesterday?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あのね。朝倉君やさしいから、余計な情報
　を知っちゃってると顔に出ちゃいそうだっ
　て……そのあたりは杉並君と私でやるから」
dialogues.en:
"Listen. We're worried that you're too nice, so you might
show some concerns on your face if we give you too much
information. Don't worry about the papers, Suginami and I
will handle it."
dialogues.text:
"Listen. We're worried that you're too nice, so you might
show some concerns on your face if we give you too much
information. Don't worry about the papers, Suginami and I
will handle it."

dialogues.jp:
両手のひらを合わせながら、ことりがごめんね、
と舌をだす。
dialogues.en:
Kotori sticks her tongue out saying sorry, and puts her
hands together in an apologetic gesture.
dialogues.text:
Kotori sticks her tongue out saying sorry, and puts her
hands together in an apologetic gesture.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、いざとなったら、夜道でストッキング
　でもかぶって尾行を――ぐっ！？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, in case of emergency, you put a stocking on your head
and follow her."
dialogues.text:
"Well, in case of emergency, you put a stocking on your head
and follow her."

dialogues.jp:
足を踏んづけて頭の下がったところに、ショー
トアッパーを打ち込む。
dialogues.en:
I step on his foot first, then I give an uppercut to his
chin when he looks down.
dialogues.text:
I step on his foot first, then I give an uppercut to his
chin when he looks down.

dialogues.jp:
「分かった。じゃあ、なにか用事があったとき
　だけお互いに連絡をするってことだな」
dialogues.en: "Okay. We contact each other only when we need to, right?"
dialogues.text: "Okay. We contact each other only when we need to, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
ぎゅっ、と両の拳を握り締めてことりが俺を見
上げる。
dialogues.en:
Making a determined fist with both hands, Kotori looks up at
me.
dialogues.text:
Making a determined fist with both hands, Kotori looks up at
me.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「がんば♪」
dialogues.en: "Let's do it!"
dialogues.text: "Let's do it!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「気張っちゃいけないんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "I mustn't put in too much effort, right?"
dialogues.text: "I mustn't put in too much effort, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうでした」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you're right."
dialogues.text: "Oh, you're right."

dialogues.jp: ふたりで顔を見合わせて苦笑いを浮かべる。
dialogues.en: We look at each other and exchange wry smiles.
dialogues.text: We look at each other and exchange wry smiles.

dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、俺はさっそく行動を開始するわ」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'll get going."
dialogues.text: "Well, I'll get going."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「青春だ……ぐっ！？」
dialogues.en: "Blossom of youth!!"
dialogues.text: "Blossom of youth!!"

dialogues.jp:
長机を支えに立ち上がろうとした物体を踏み潰
して、俺は帰路についた。
dialogues.en: I stand up from the long table and head home.
dialogues.text: I stand up from the long table and head home.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくら先生を助ける会◆
dialogues.en: ◆The committee to save Sakura-sensei◆
dialogues.text: ◆The committee to save Sakura-sensei◆

dialogues.jp:
半ドンの土曜日、茶屋でことりや杉並と一緒に、
さくらを助ける案を練る。
dialogues.en:
In a half-day on Saturday, I discussed ideas for saving
Sakura with Suginami and Kotori at the cafeteria.
dialogues.text:
In a half-day on Saturday, I discussed ideas for saving
Sakura with Suginami and Kotori at the cafeteria.

dialogues.jp:
あまり思い切ったことは出来ないが、アリバイ
や本人を見張る意味をこめて、俺の仕事はさく
らを一日中監視することになった。
dialogues.en:
I was given the job to monitor Sakura all day long as a
bodyguard to establish her alibi.
dialogues.text:
I was given the job to monitor Sakura all day long as a
bodyguard to establish her alibi.
